criteria: dense or legally consequential treatment of shared authorities
older report-format decisions as well as neutral-citation decisions
representation from SCC, FCA, ONCA, BCCA, NSCA, and YKCA
opinion structure difficult for the conservative deterministic detector

cases.name: R. v. Hasselwander
cases.selection_reason: split reasons use some of the same firearms authorities differently

cases.selection_reason: split reasons address Winko, Palmer, Biniaris, and related authorities differently

cases.name: Felipa v. Canada (Citizenship and Immigration)
cases.selection_reason: dense split decision with more than forty proposition treatments divided across two sides

cases.name: Romspen Investment Corporation v. Courtice Auto Wreckers Limited

cases.name: R. v. Morgentaler

cases.name: Egan v. Canada
